intro: Designed to be more than just a coffee table, Skyline perfectly balances elegance and practicality for your home. Whether you’re hosting friends or enjoying your coffee, it’s makes every moment last.

features.title: A bold statement with a modern touch
features.text: Add a touch of sophistication to your living space with digitally back-printed skyline pattern that complements modern and classic interiors alike.

features.title: Toughened glass that stands up to life
features.text: Crafted with durable toughened glass, the table top offers superior strength and scratch resistance, ensuring long-lasting beauty.

features.title: Smart storage, always within reach
features.text: Access your essentials effortlessly with storage accessible from both sides, combining convenience and streamlined organization.

features.title: Perfect for small or spacious settings
features.text: Designed to fit perfectly in any room, this table optimises space while providing ample functionality.

features.title: Built to last, made for you
features.text: Built to last, the sturdy engineering timber construction ensures reliable performance for your daily lifestyle needs.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
